trust_decision.summary: Whether the requesting user may read/update a document (and see per-collection health data) in a given upload collection is decided by Payload collection access, which the plugin bypasses: its endpoints only run the plugin-level auth gate and then call the Local API with the default overrideAccess:true, and the health scan reads with overrideAccess:true and is returned unfiltered.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'Alt Text Endpoint' and the omitted `overrideAccess`; the single-image generate endpoint's findByID/update calls are the obvious Local API calls without it.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/alt-text-plugin/health (alt-text/src/endpoints/altTextHealth.ts:15) and exported public API getAltTextHealth (alt-text/src/exports/server.ts:2)
Admin dashboard widget server component (alt-text/src/components/AltTextHealthWidget.tsx:18-19, registered at alt-text/src/plugin.ts:21-32)
fix_sites.module_kind: utility consumed by React server component

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: alt-text/src/utilities/altTextHealth.ts:245-257 (dashboard widget data, rendered by alt-text/src/components/AltTextHealthWidget.tsx:18-19), plus the shared scan at alt-text/src/utilities/altTextHealth.ts:241-243 exported as public API at alt-text/src/exports/server.ts:2

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The health scan is a separate reporting feature that deliberately reads with an explicit `overrideAccess: true` (alt-text/src/utilities/altTextHealth.ts:110) to build a shared cached aggregate, returns only counts/IDs and never writes, so it looks like intentional design rather than the 'generate endpoint' omission the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The health scan must stay a single complete, cache-shared elevated-access computation (cache key has no user component) while being filtered per request; users whose read access is a scoped Where must still see their collection; preview generation (update:false) must keep working for users who may read but not update.

O6_input_shapes: array of ids (bulk endpoint, per-id findByID)
per-locale update loop (bulk endpoint, one update per locale)
preview (update:false) vs persist (update:true) on the single endpoint
collection read access returning true / false / a Where constraint / throwing (health filter)
error entries tagged with a collection vs untagged (health filter)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Health aggregate for a collection whose read access is a scoped Where: the whole collection's counts and invalidDocIds are returned, not only the docs the Where admits.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The aggregate is collection-level by design; the published fix explicitly treats a Where as granting the collection (fix.diff:1131-1135, fix.diff:1329-1341).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the health fix site; another feature from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third endpoint, e.g. 'generate for all missing alt texts in a collection', that runs payload.find + payload.update without overrideAccess:false/user.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The widget already lists invalidDocIds per collection (alt-text/src/components/AltTextHealthWidget.tsx:121-138); a 'fix all' action next to it is a natural feature and would copy the existing endpoint idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An auto-generate-on-upload collection hook that calls req.payload.update without passing req/user, writing alt/keywords under elevated access.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The plugin already attaches afterChange hooks to the tracked collections; auto-generation on upload is a common feature request for alt-text plugins.

O9_family: CWE-863 incorrect authorization: Payload Local API default overrideAccess:true bypasses collection access in plugin endpoints and an elevated-access cached aggregate.

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=22.12 (alt-text/package.json:101-102), pnpm workspace, tests via node --experimental-strip-types --test (alt-text/package.json:29); the fix switches to vitest
O10_build.project_tests: alt-text/test/*.test.ts (health summarize, mimeTypes, endpoint schemas, field validate) with mocked payload objects; no endpoint access tests at the pinned commit. Hidden tests can mock req.payload.findByID/update and collections[slug].config.access.read as the fix's tests do (fix.diff:1424-1449, fix.diff:1261-1273).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add overrideAccess:false + user to the generate endpoint's findByID/update only (missing bulk per-locale updates and the health/widget aggregate), or flip the health find to overrideAccess:false inside the user-agnostic cached compute, so one user's view gets cached and served to others.

out_of_scope_notes: Other plugins in the monorepo (content-translator, pages, chat-agent) also call the Local API with overrideAccess options (e.g. pages/src/utils/getBreadcrumbs.ts:200 overrideAccess:true); different packages and sinks, not pursued.
Generate endpoints accept any collection slug, not only plugin-configured ones (alt-text/src/endpoints/schemas.ts:7, :13); not an access-control issue once collection access applies.
unverified: Repo size not measured (no shell); the alt-text package is small (~35 source files) and the monorepo likely has under 5 MB of source, so tiny_repo may apply but was not confirmed.

O8 Where-scoped residual: the maintainer deliberately chose collection granularity, so a hidden test for it is only fair if the report states the doc-level property; presence in latest unknown (no latest release given).
